config.label: Fetch records
config.query:
SELECT
    a.patient_id,
    a.expected_time,
    a.appointment_date,
    p.contact_number,
    p.full_name
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p
    ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
WHERE a.status = 'PENDING';
